summary: Iteration 11 verification of 4 user-reported bugs after iteration 10. All 4 bugs fixed and all regressions pass. Backend 6/6 (test_iteration7_regression.py). Frontend 7/7 flows (bug1 oauth hash-clear, bug2 email/password login for 3 roles landing on correct dashboards with inputs reflecting typed values, bug3 'Create an account' removed with helper hint present, bug4 Landing CTA section removed, anon gate on 9 protected paths, authed /login redirect, logout).
critical_code_review_comments: dashFor() helper is now duplicated in Login.jsx, Register.jsx (per prev iter), and AuthCallback.jsx. Recommend extracting to /app/frontend/src/lib/roles.js to enforce DRY.
Login.jsx still keeps both an in-component `if (user) <Navigate>` guard AND a post-submit imperative navigate(). Consolidating to guard-only would be cleaner (carried over from iter10 review).
seed_data_creation: None new. Backend regression reuses TEST_ReservOwner create+cancel from iter7 regression suite.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Iteration 11 CLOSED. All four user-reported bugs from iter10 finish are resolved:
- BUG1 (Google OAuth loop): AuthCallback.jsx now calls window.history.replaceState BEFORE navigate on both success and failure paths, verified by code inspection and by simulating /#session_id=FAKE_TEST_123 which yields path=/login and hash='' after failed exchange.
- BUG2 (login inputs unresponsive): Verified that data-testid=login-email/login-password accept keystrokes and .input_value() returns exactly what was typed for all 3 demo users; submit lands on the correct role dashboard (/menu, /kitchen, /staff).
- BUG3 ('Create an account' link removed): getByText('Create an account').count()==0 on /login; helper hint 'First time here? Just tap Continue with Google above...' present.
- BUG4 (Landing CTA removed): On /, 'Taste the future' text count=0, no [data-testid=cta-signup], no [data-testid=cta-menu]; page ends with ROLES then footer.
Regressions: anon → 9 protected paths all redirect to /login; authed chef visiting /login → /kitchen; logout from dropdown returns to /login. Backend pytest suite (test_iteration7_regression.py) 6/6 pass.
NOTE for future testers: Always clear both cookies AND localStorage between tests. In initial mixed run, a leftover session_token cookie caused AuthCallback failure path to land on /menu instead of /login. Re-run in isolated clean-state confirmed correct behavior.
rca of the issue: N/A — all four bugs verified fixed. AuthCallback loop fix RCA (per code): previously hash '#session_id=...' persisted after navigate, causing AppRouter to re-mount AuthCallback in a loop; now window.history.replaceState wipes the fragment before navigation, breaking the loop.
